evals.prompt: We're exposing our internal billing API as an MCP server over HTTPS. Sketch auth, tool design, and the minimum security bar before we ship.
evals.expected_output: Invokes ns-mcp-shield: requires OAuth 2.1/OIDC, no token passthrough, schema-validated tools, HITL for high-risk actions; walks minimum-bar checklist; cites controls sections.

evals.prompt: Review this MCP tool that shells out with unsanitized model input and stores the user's API key in a process-global dict.
evals.expected_output: Invokes ns-mcp-shield as a review: findings for injection and isolation failures mapped to vulnerability landscape risks, with concrete controls; unmet minimum-bar items treated as findings.

evals.prompt: Audit CSP and security headers on our Next.js app — no MCP involved.
evals.expected_output: Does not use ns-mcp-shield as primary; routes to ns-best-practices instead.
